newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WASPS SIGN WESTERN SAMOA HOOKER LEOTA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WASPS SIGN WESTERN SAMOA HOOKER LEOTA.

text.p: Wasps have signed Western Samoan hooker Trevor Leota as a reinforcement to help them retain the English league title next season.
The West London club said on Friday that New Zealand-based Leota was signed after impressing the club on a tour of Britain and Ireland last year.
Wasps' director of rugby Nigel Melville said that the Auckland Colts player was "an excellent prospect".
Saracens said they had reinforced their squad with three newcomers from Australia and New Zealand.
They were wing Brendon Daniel from New Zealand, Queensland scrumhalf Bradley Free and Australian international centre Ryan Constable. All three have British passports.
